result.summary: Do not ship: Save Settings now silently resets General settings and discards edits.

findings.title: Split forms cause every settings save to overwrite General configuration
findings.body: General controls now belong to a separate form with no submit button. The Save Settings button at line 241 submits only instance fields. save_settings in triggarr/web/routes.py:530–539 replaces omitted General values with defaults and persists them: for example, hard_max_per_cycle=10 becomes 0 (unlimited), skip_unreleased=true becomes false, and max_history_rows=10000 becomes 1000. General edits cannot be saved through the button either. The existing test_general_fields_submit_with_the_save_settings_form explicitly guards this regression.
findings.recommendation: Restore id="settings-form" on the instance form and form="settings-form" on every General control, keeping the Security forms independent.

next_steps: Restore the shared form association and run the existing General-field submission regression test.
